candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating downstream order-service latency/unavailability.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-service-side logs/metrics not in evidence; cannot confirm whether latency originates in order, its dependencies (inventory/payment/postgresql), or network.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout with client transport errors to order at ~2s; metrics show checkout p95 ~2406ms and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is downstream of gateway but exact failing hop unconfirmed.
